say:1:1641117001:1.text: Now, as for intel gathering, sure, the simplest method is to grease a few palms. Drop a gold coin or two, and lips start flapping.
say:1:1641117001:1.source_cn: 说到打探情报的技巧，我认为最简单的做法，就是买通线人。...
say:1:1641117001:1.male: Now, as for intel gathering, sure, the simplest method is to grease a few palms. Drop a gold coin or two, and lips start flapping.
say:1:1641117001:1.female: Now, as for intel gathering, sure, the simplest method is to grease a few palms. Drop a gold coin or two, and lips start flapping.

say:2:1641117002:1.text: The problem is, most informants tend to wear more than one hat.
say:2:1641117002:1.source_cn: 但问题是——很多线人都不止有一个身份。
say:2:1641117002:1.male: The problem is, most informants tend to wear more than one hat.
say:2:1641117002:1.female: The problem is, most informants tend to wear more than one hat.

say:3:1641117003:1.text: They might be vendors by day, shadow brokers by night—or worse, smiling as they serve you while reporting everything you say to someone else.
say:3:1641117003:1.source_cn: 他们白天可能是商贩，晚上却是地下情报贩子，或者看似在为...
say:3:1641117003:1.male: They might be vendors by day, shadow brokers by night—or worse, smiling as they serve you while reporting everything you say to someone else.
say:3:1641117003:1.female: They might be vendors by day, shadow brokers by night—or worse, smiling as they serve you while reporting everything you say to someone else.

say:4:1641117004:1.text: That's why I prefer the safer route: getting my own hands dirty.
say:4:1641117004:1.source_cn: 所以，还一种稳妥的做法，这需要我们亲自入场。
say:4:1641117004:1.male: That's why I prefer the safer route: getting my own hands dirty.
say:4:1641117004:1.female: That's why I prefer the safer route: getting my own hands dirty.

say:5:1641117005:1.text: Information doesn't fall from the sky. It trickles in—only after you've played your part convincingly.
say:5:1641117005:1.source_cn: 情报不会从天而降，它只会在你“扮演好角色”后，主动流进...
say:5:1641117005:1.male: Information doesn't fall from the sky. It trickles in—only after you've played your part convincingly.
say:5:1641117005:1.female: Information doesn't fall from the sky. It trickles in—only after you've played your part convincingly.

choice_prompt:6:1641117005.text: Information doesn't fall from the sky. It trickles in—only after you've played your part convincingly.
choice_prompt:6:1641117005.source_cn: 情报不会从天而降，它只会在你“扮演好角色”后，主动流进你的耳朵。

choice_prompt:6:1641117005.female: Information doesn't fall from the sky. It trickles in—only after you've played your part convincingly.

say:7:1641117007:1.text: First rule: disappear into the noise. That's the easy part.
say:7:1641117007:1.source_cn: 当然，隐藏在喧嚣中只是第一步。
say:7:1641117007:1.male: First rule: disappear into the noise. That's the easy part.
say:7:1641117007:1.female: First rule: disappear into the noise. That's the easy part.

say:8:1641117008:1.text: The real trick is making people believe you're one of them.
say:8:1641117008:1.source_cn: 打探情报的关键，是让别人以为“你也是他们的一份子”。
say:8:1641117008:1.male: The real trick is making people believe you're one of them.
say:8:1641117008:1.female: The real trick is making people believe you're one of them.

say:9:1641117009:1.text: A merchant talks freely to another merchant. A drunk confesses only to another drunk.
say:9:1641117009:1.source_cn: 商人会更愿意同商人说话，酒客只会对另一个酒客吐露真心。
say:9:1641117009:1.male: A merchant talks freely to another merchant. A drunk confesses only to another drunk.
say:9:1641117009:1.female: A merchant talks freely to another merchant. A drunk confesses only to another drunk.

say:10:1641117010:1.text: But the second you smell even a little like an outsider—zip! The whole room goes quiet.
say:10:1641117010:1.source_cn: 而如果你不慎露出了“外来者”的气息，他们就会立刻闭嘴。
say:10:1641117010:1.male: But the second you smell even a little like an outsider—zip! The whole room goes quiet.
say:10:1641117010:1.female: But the second you smell even a little like an outsider—zip! The whole room goes quiet.

choice_prompt:11:1641117010.text: But the second you smell even a little like an outsider—zip! The whole room goes quiet.

choice_prompt:11:1641117010.male: But the second you smell even a little like an outsider—zip! The whole room goes quiet.
choice_prompt:11:1641117010.female: But the second you smell even a little like an outsider—zip! The whole room goes quiet.

say:12:1641117011:1.text: Then casually steer the chat toward something harmless. Make it seem like you were never prying in the first place.
say:12:1641117011:1.source_cn: 那就转移话题，装作你本来就是为了别的事情而来。
say:12:1641117011:1.male: Then casually steer the chat toward something harmless. Make it seem like you were never prying in the first place.
say:12:1641117011:1.female: Then casually steer the chat toward something harmless. Make it seem like you were never prying in the first place.

say:13:1641117012:1.text: And remember, knowing when to retreat is part of the job. Push too hard, and you become the hunted.
say:13:1641117012:1.source_cn: 不过要注意的是——“及时撤退”也是调查的一部分。死咬着...
say:13:1641117012:1.male: And remember, knowing when to retreat is part of the job. Push too hard, and you become the hunted.
say:13:1641117012:1.female: And remember, knowing when to retreat is part of the job. Push too hard, and you become the hunted.

say:14:1641117016:1.text: So, what do you think, Magister Merlin? Was any of that actually useful?
say:14:1641117016:1.source_cn: 怎么样？梅林大人，我的技巧对您有帮助吗？
say:14:1641117016:1.male: So, what do you think, Magister Merlin? Was any of that actually useful?
say:14:1641117016:1.female: So, what do you think, Magister Merlin? Was any of that actually useful?

choice_prompt:15:1641117016.text: So, what do you think, Magister Merlin? Was any of that actually useful?

choice_prompt:15:1641117016.male: So, what do you think, Magister Merlin? Was any of that actually useful?
choice_prompt:15:1641117016.female: So, what do you think, Magister Merlin? Was any of that actually useful?

say:16:1641117017:1.text: Thank you for the kind words.
say:16:1641117017:1.male: Thank you for the kind words.
say:16:1641117017:1.female: Thank you for the kind words.

say:17:1641117019:1.text: Here's to success, for both of us.
say:17:1641117019:1.male: Here's to success, for both of us.
say:17:1641117019:1.female: Here's to success, for both of us.

say:19:1641117018:1.text: Then I consider it an honor to share common ground with you.
say:19:1641117018:1.source_cn: 能获得您的部分认同，也是我的荣幸。
say:19:1641117018:1.male: Then I consider it an honor to share common ground with you.
say:19:1641117018:1.female: Then I consider it an honor to share common ground with you.

choice:15:1:2.text: Truth be told, our approaches aren't so different.
choice:15:1:2.male: Truth be told, our approaches aren't so different.
choice:15:1:2.female: Truth be told, our approaches aren't so different.

choice:11:0:1.text: And what if they catch on?
choice:11:0:1.male: And what if they catch on?
choice:11:0:1.female: And what if they catch on?

say:20:1641117013:1.source_cn: 直接的方法也有，比如说“施压”。

say:21:1641117014:1.text: But that rarely yields what you're looking for. At best, you get half-truths; more often, outright fabrications.
say:21:1641117014:1.source_cn: 但那样得到的答案往往只是一半真相，甚至是对方编造出来的谎言。
say:21:1641117014:1.male: But that rarely yields what you're looking for. At best, you get half-truths; more often, outright fabrications.
say:21:1641117014:1.female: But that rarely yields what you're looking for. At best, you get half-truths; more often, outright fabrications.

say:22:1641117015:1.text: So unless the clock is ticking, I prefer the long game.
say:22:1641117015:1.source_cn: 所以除非时间紧迫，我更倾向于迂回。
say:22:1641117015:1.male: So unless the clock is ticking, I prefer the long game.
say:22:1641117015:1.female: So unless the clock is ticking, I prefer the long game.

choice:11:1:2.text: Is there a more straightforward approach?
choice:11:1:2.male: Is there a more straightforward approach?
choice:11:1:2.female: Is there a more straightforward approach?

choice:6:0:1.text: So how do you go about blending in?
choice:6:0:1.male: So how do you go about blending in?
choice:6:0:1.female: So how do you go about blending in?

say:23:1641117006:1.text: Simple. Move with the crowd. Match their rhythm. Before long, you're just another face in the flow.
say:23:1641117006:1.source_cn: 只要安静地跟随人群，顺着他们的节奏走，你的存在就会被“...
say:23:1641117006:1.male: Simple. Move with the crowd. Match their rhythm. Before long, you're just another face in the flow.
say:23:1641117006:1.female: Simple. Move with the crowd. Match their rhythm. Before long, you're just another face in the flow.
